about: One person asks Friday one thing and, a few seconds later, Forge another: each acknowledges and answers once, never both at the same time.

lines.say: Friday, what does the Workspace plan cost per month?
Forge, how many agents come with a new workspace?

expect.why: one piece of work per request, no more
two agents never speak at the same time
Friday's acknowledgement must not run over the second question
no sentence twice; the short fixed acknowledgement may be the same for both agents
2 acknowledgements + 2 answers, with room for an answer in two sentences; more is filler
agents do not talk to or about each other aloud
agents do not talk to or about each other aloud
